tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Sampled from the Bahria logo. The cover title band, exercise banners, section headings, table header rows, the TASK label, the header rule, the cover page border and the code file-name bar. White text on navy passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Sampled from the logo ring. Details-table values on the cover, the banner title cell, the answer row of a table and the light cells of a grid figure. Text on sky is ink or navy, never white.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Tint of sky. The ground of code blocks and every second row of a data table. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Sampled from the logo wreath. The rules above and below the cover title band, under the department line, under each exercise banner and above the footer; the fill of the RESULT label; the ring of path nodes in figures. Never used for text on paper.

tokens.name: flame
tokens.usage: Sampled from the logo torch. Kept for the logo only; reports do not use it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Sampled from the logo lettering. Body text, table cells, code and the RESULT label.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Campus line, banner tags, captions, the header course line, the footer student line and h values in figures. Passes 4.5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: under section headings, around the Task and Result box, table body borders, the code frame and the frame of every screenshot.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground, every first table row, and the text colour on navy fills.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Docstrings and comments in code blocks, italic.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Edges in figures that are not on the answer path.

styles.name: cover-university
styles.usage: Uppercase, navy, centred under the logo. 26 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: cover-campus
styles.usage: Uppercase, muted, wide-spaced. 12 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: cover-department
styles.usage: Ink, over a short gold rule. 13 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: band-label
styles.usage: Uppercase, gold, on the navy title band. 11 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: band-title
styles.usage: White on the navy title band. 30 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: band-caption

styles.name: details-label
styles.usage: Uppercase, white on navy. 9 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: details-value
styles.usage: Ink on sky; the name in bold. 12 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: banner-label
styles.usage: Sky on navy, over the number. 7.5 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: banner-number
styles.usage: White on navy, two digits. 22 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: banner-title
styles.usage: Navy on sky. 17 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: banner-tag
styles.usage: Uppercase, muted, under the banner title. 9 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: box-label
styles.usage: TASK white on navy, RESULT ink on gold. 8.5 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: box-text
styles.sample: Write a Python program that performs greedy best first search.
styles.usage: Ink, line height 1.21. 11 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: box-answer
styles.usage: The answer inside the Result text, navy. 12 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: Navy over a rule hairline. 13 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I treated the table as a grid.
styles.usage: Ink, line height 1.25. 11 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Table 1: Dry run of greedy best first search from S to G.
styles.usage: Italic, muted, centred under every figure, table and screenshot. 9 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: table-header
styles.usage: Uppercase, white on navy. 8.5 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: table-cell
styles.usage: Ink; the first column bold; the answer row bold navy on sky. 10.5 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: grid-label
styles.usage: A grid figure cell: white on navy for the path, navy on sky otherwise. 17 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: grid-note
styles.usage: Under a grid label: sky on navy, muted on sky. 9 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: code-file
styles.usage: White on the navy file-name bar. 8 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: On sky-soft: comments and docstrings code-comment italic, keywords navy bold, strings code-string, the rest ink. 8.5 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: header-title
styles.usage: Navy, after the small logo, left of the header. 10 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: header-course
styles.usage: Muted, right of the header. 9 pt in Word and PDF.

styles.name: footer
styles.usage: Muted student line on the left, Page N bold navy on the right. 9 pt in Word and PDF.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; gap under a section heading.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside the Task and Result box; gap between paragraphs and blocks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page margin on screen. In Word and PDF: A4, 0.85 inch left and right, 1.04 inch top.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything in a report: bands, boxes, tables, code and screenshot frames. The theme is square, like a printed lab sheet.
